items.title: Witch Dipping Candles
items.alt: A witch lifts two wax candles joined by a wick above a dipping pot.
items.description: A witch lifts a pair of wax tapers joined by one wick above a narrow dipping pot; a single smooth wax drip hangs below. Use this illustration for traditional craft lessons and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch with a Leaf Umbrella
items.alt: A witch walks under a leaf umbrella with a small snail on its handle.
items.description: A witch in a short rain cape walks with an oversized leaf umbrella over one shoulder and a tiny snail perched on the umbrella handle. Use this illustration for rainy-day personal crafts and personal crafts.

items.title: Witch Sorting Magical Keys
items.alt: An older witch with glasses compares two decorative keys.
items.description: An older witch with round spectacles compares two ornate keys, a short key ring hanging from her belt, no table clutter. Use this illustration for matching and counting activities and personal crafts.
